title: Coating thickness: a t-test
intro: A paint line is set to apply a coating **50 µm** thick. An inspector measures **n = 12** panels: mean **x̄ = 52.1 µm**, standard deviation **s = 3.0 µm**. σ is not known, so the test is a t-test with n − 1 = 11 degrees of freedom. H₀: μ = 50 against H₁: μ ≠ 50, at α = 0.05.
